generated.brand-mark.description: A newly generated neutral logo mark for the operator's brand (same 18x28 box).

generated.project-visual.description: Generated or abstract artwork on a surface.tile-* fill standing in for client work (ratios from asset-manifest imageSlots).

placeholder.client-logo.description: A neutral monogram tile (1:1) for a fictional client; never a real logo.
